section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section lists the instruments used in the study (Body Appreciation Scale [BAS], MBSRQ-AE, MEIM, RSES, SATAQ-3 Internalization-General, EAT-26 Dieting subscale, EDE-Q with subscales, PARTS Weight/Size Teasing) and reports Cronbach's alphas for each in the current sample. A Demographics Questionnaire asked participants to report age, year in school, ethnicity, gender, height, and weight (height/weight imply BMI would be derived from self-report). The section does not report sample size, country, survey method, percent white, mean age, mean BMI, source of sample, correlations between body appreciation and BMI, or publication type.
